content.text:
I removed the priority colours. Each todo now shows its priority as a plain grey label (HIGH, MED, LOW), the same for all three. I haven't checked it in a browser.
This replaces the colour part of DEC-005 and the left stripe from DEC-006. The low/med/high values, the priority select, the `data-priority` attribute and the high-to-low sorting are unchanged.
I didn't try toning the colours down or removing the label, because muted colours would still compete with the red overdue highlight and priorities still need to be visible.
